The protected call publishes URL_UPDATED with standalone saving disabled. The success append carries status submitted and the notification, whose returned URL takes precedence.
A caught failure appends the original input URL with status failed and String(error) from that occurrence, then continues.
The exhausted success and failure array is saved under indexing/reindex_batch before return, including on empty input.

gaps.reason: The protected log can fail before SDK entry. The post-entry failure case leaves the remote outcome unspecified and does not distinguish SDK rejection from later mapping or append failure. A throw in the catch itself or the aggregate save can still interrupt completion.
